title: Mid Summer Meltdown at Ferndale
description: Men's and Women's triples tournament hosted by Level Up Volleyball, relocated this year to Ferndale High School to support their volleyball program. Divisions: Men's & Women's AA/Open, A, and BB; high school girls (grades 10–12); junior high (grades 7–9). Cost: $25 per person, payable by Venmo or cash on the day of the event. Cash prize for AA/Open; apparel prizes for all other divisions. Surface inferred as outdoor grass (Level Up Volleyball runs outdoor grass tournaments) — confirm before publishing.
